body.content: Re-evaluating the p^6 * q^2 boundary. For p=2, m=64*q^2. We need 2006 <= 64*q^2 < 12005. This means 31.34 <= q^2 < 187.57. Thus q must be a prime in [6, 13]. Primes are {7, 11, 13}. For p=3, m=729*q^2. We need 2006 <= 729*q^2 < 12005. This means 2.75 <= q^2 < 16.45. Primes are {2, 3}. But q must be distinct from p, so q=2. For p=5, m=15625*q^2, which is always > 12005. The set {911, 1131, 5739, 8811} is robust.
body.why_keep_this: Rigorous boundary check to resolve discrepancies between SRC_003, SRC_004, and SRC_005.
